description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ClientTrait' that provides method signatures and implementations for sending HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.) synchronously and asynchronously, as part of the GuzzleHttp client library.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Abstract method to create and send an HTTP request with specified method, URI, and options.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP GET request.

methods.name: head
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP HEAD request.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP PUT request.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP POST request.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP PATCH request.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP DELETE request.

methods.name: requestAsync
methods.description: Abstract method to create and send an asynchronous HTTP request.

methods.name: getAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP GET request.

methods.name: headAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP HEAD request.

methods.name: putAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP PUT request.

methods.name: postAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP POST request.

methods.name: patchAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP PATCH request.

methods.name: deleteAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP DELETE request.
